description: Abstract class defining form field information within the OFBiz widget model, including field types, sources, and rendering methods.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: Abstract class representing metadata and behavior for form fields in the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on this FieldInfo instance.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of this FieldInfo instance with a specified ModelFormField.

methods.name: getFieldSource
methods.description: Returns the source type of the field.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: renderFieldString
methods.description: Renders the field as a string using provided context and renderer.
